content.name: Rosa Villanueva
content.title: Clinical Supervisor, Medical Assistants (CMA)
content.summary: Certified Medical Assistant (AAMA) with 13 years in family medicine and cardiology clinics, now supervising 24 medical assistants across four primary care sites. I built the MA training academy that cut new-hire onboarding from 10 weeks to 6 and helped our clinics close 3,100 overdue preventive-care gaps in a single year.

experience.title: Medical Assistant
bullets: Roomed 28–32 patients a day for three family physicians, taking vitals, medication histories and chief complaints in athenahealth.
Performed venipuncture, rapid strep and A1c point-of-care tests and kept CLIA-waived testing logs audit-ready.
Administered childhood and adult vaccines under provider orders and reconciled state immunization registry records weekly.

experience.title: Cardiology Medical Assistant
bullets: Performed 12-lead EKGs, applied Holter and event monitors and prepped patients for 15–20 stress tests a week.
Managed the anticoagulation recall list for 640 warfarin patients, raising on-time clotting-test checks from 72% to 93%.
Trained 6 new medical assistants on cardiology workflows and wrote the clinic's first EKG troubleshooting guide.

experience.title: Lead Medical Assistant
bullets: Led 9 medical assistants at a 12-provider clinic seeing about 260 patients a day, handling schedules, huddles and supply ordering.
Set up a curbside and telehealth intake workflow in two weeks during COVID-19, keeping visit volume at 85% of normal.
Introduced pre-visit planning huddles that closed 1,200 care gaps for mammograms, colorectal screening and diabetic eye exams in one year.
Cut supply spend by $38,000 a year by moving to par-level ordering and tracking expiry dates in a shared log.

experience.title: Clinical Supervisor, Medical Assistants
bullets: Supervise 24 medical assistants across four clinic sites, owning hiring, competency checks, scheduling and annual reviews.
Built an in-house MA training academy with skills labs and shadowing, shortening onboarding from 10 weeks to 6.
Partnered with the quality team on standing orders for screenings, helping close 3,100 preventive-care gaps in 2024.
Reduced MA turnover from 34% to 18% by creating a three-step career ladder tied to CMA certification and lead roles.
